text:
lina: Quick question — can we land PR #2789 before tonight's maintenance window (23:00 UTC)? CI is flaky on `integration/mac-e2e` and the rebase window closes at 22:30. Need a quick plan. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

tara: what's the failing test? small change or infra flake?

lina: looks infra-y. Failure in `RenderServiceSpec::renders-with-gpu` 2/3 runs, same stacktrace. PR is a small routing change, low risk.

ci-bot: CI update: `integration/mac-e2e` failed (2/3). Rerun queued (job 9842). ETA ~8m. Logs: `OOM when allocating KV cache` on one node.

ken: if rerun passes we can still land before 22:30, but we should avoid merging during the blackout. deploy-bot: Reminder — nightly maintenance 23:00-00:30 UTC. No merges during blackout unless emergency.

sam: can we do a manual smoke after merge and hold the rollout to 10%? I can watch the canary.

maria: I can grab manual smoke tests (db + routes) once CI green. Will ping when done.

tara: @ken @lina two asks: 1) rebase quickly onto `main` (should be trivial), 2) add a single line to the PR description noting the smoke owner and canary percentage. Then I can approve.

lina: rebase done and pushed. Added smoke owner + canary 10% to PR description.

ci-bot: CI update: rerun (job 9842) succeeded. All checks green.

ken: approved. :+1:

tara: approved pending smoke sign-off from @maria.

maria: smoke done — basic flows look good, no errors. Observability shows normal request rates.

lina: thanks — proceeding to merge at 21:50 UTC, will hold rollout at 10% and escalate if errors.

sam: I'll be on watch for the next 30m. ping me if anything odd. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Merge recorded: PR #2789 merged to main by lina at 1725009500. Canary rollout 10% started.

lina: follow-up — if things are stable by 22:30 we'll increase to 100% outside maintenance window, otherwise we'll rollback before blackout.

ken: sounds good. Cheers everyone. :rocket:
